2B69FC3344A16D97863605998D8A7B81.source: The well is deep and cold. Far below, something glints — a copper coin, wished upon long ago.
2B69FC3344A16D97863605998D8A7B81.target: 井又深又冷。井底深处有什么东西闪了一下——是一枚铜币，很久以前有人对着它许过愿。

14A49E0EA72EDBF2ADD5DA8B66945878.source: The door is latched. Somewhere inside, a kettle begins to sing.
14A49E0EA72EDBF2ADD5DA8B66945878.target: 门上了闩。屋里不知何处，一只水壶唱起歌来。

62B42CE4EC39BDB5DEA1F3CD9C7D5BBF.source: {Windmill Hill}. On a clear evening you can see the whole valley from here — and, some say, a little of tomorrow.
62B42CE4EC39BDB5DEA1F3CD9C7D5BBF.target: {风车丘}。晴朗的傍晚，从这里能望见整座山谷——据说，还能望见一点点明天。

532BFDDF2C5FBDABBCDE98B07F8A59EF.source: A neat little door with a brass knocker shaped like a leaf. Nobody answers.
532BFDDF2C5FBDABBCDE98B07F8A59EF.target: 一扇整洁的小门，门上挂着树叶形状的黄铜门环。无人应答。

638FE502B9DB304DBD5816D5B68E29CD.source: Someone has added, in smaller letters: "They are not as friendly as they look."
638FE502B9DB304DBD5816D5B68E29CD.target: 有人用小字补了一句：“它们可没看上去那么友善。”

9333E2A2D736223ADBF3C6AA67A9F207.source: Laughter and the smell of stew drift through the door of the {Ember & Oak}.
9333E2A2D736223ADBF3C6AA67A9F207.target: {烬火橡木旅店}的门里飘出阵阵笑声和炖菜的香气。

892077E776AC665409CEA91041246A53.target: Luminati 2.5D 像素艺术引擎 · three.js

A6AA2205454A3523042D94EF703E76D7.source: Fresh bread cools on the sill. You resist. Barely.
A6AA2205454A3523042D94EF703E76D7.target: 窗台上晾着刚出炉的面包。你忍住了。勉强忍住了。

A57C15192A26CDD30C1D32A1D85DB4E6.source: Where the valley keeps its winds

A495D919EC37E353EF6D07BB5DCA9DCC.source: {Amberleaf Grove}. Please do not feed the fireflies.

C602FD04D59FA5BA3957FC61BB5AA015.source: The barn smells of hay and patience. A cow regards you with polite indifference.
C602FD04D59FA5BA3957FC61BB5AA015.target: 谷仓里弥漫着干草与耐心的气味。一头奶牛以礼貌的漠然打量着你。

DCC274E7E643474BD02F1DC797649631.source: You make a small wish of your own.
DCC274E7E643474BD02F1DC797649631.target: 你也悄悄许下了一个小小的心愿。

E93F3371C9DA685CB2185C223CC5868C.target: Luminati 2.5D 像素艺术引擎演示

EC902C499E780D432A29B99BD3CBC9D0.source: Split firewood is stacked high against the wall. Someone inside is humming a song about axes.
EC902C499E780D432A29B99BD3CBC9D0.target: 劈好的柴火靠墙堆得高高的。屋里有人正哼着一首关于斧头的歌。
